milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate to the open oak pavilion and look at the potted fern on the oak slab pedestal at spawn-relative (5, 2, 5). max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually approached the pavilion (not just standing at spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the potted fern, confirming visual identification. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because it correctly models 'player can see the target' by combining proximity with facing direction.
